# Alert

Inline, prominent message. Uses role=alert for destructive and warning, role=status otherwise. Tinted backgrounds stay at 8% so text keeps full contrast.

## Accessibility

- Behaviour and semantics are summarized above; keyboard and screen reader behaviour follow the WAI-ARIA pattern of the underlying primitive.
- `alert.test.tsx` covers rendering, variants and interaction with Testing Library and runs axe-core on the rendered output (contrast is checked at token level). Every story also runs axe-core's default rule set in the Storybook browser tests; violations fail the run.
- Colors come from semantic tokens whose contrast is checked in both themes by `pnpm tokens:check`.
